title: Protocol to Process Gastruloids for FACS
author: Stefano D Vianello
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bvgrn3v6
materials: If using beads as positive references, prepare bead tubes just before FACS processing. For GFP BrightComp eBeads™ Compensation Bead Kit (Invitrogen/Thermo Fisher Scientific, CAT#A10514): vortex vial for 00:00:10 s Dispense 1 drop into a clean FACS tube Resuspend in 1mL Staining Buffer

steps.title: Harvest Gastruloids
steps.instruction: Harvest Gastruloids from each well of a 96 well plate and collect them in a 15mL Falcon tube, pooling by timepoint or condition.

steps.title: Wash Gastruloids
steps.instruction: Wash the Gastruloids to remove N2B27 medium.

substeps.instruction: Allow Gastruloids to settle to the bottom of the tube and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend Gastruloids in 5mL PBS-/- to wash away traces of N2B27.
Allow Gastruloids to re-settle and aspirate the PBS-/-.

steps.title: Digest Gastruloids
steps.instruction: Perform a two-stage enzymatic digestion to create a single cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Add 1mL Digestion Solution (3mg/mL Collagenase IV, 4mg/mL Dispase, 100ug/mL DNAseI, in PBS-/-) and incubate at 37 °C (waterbath) for 4 minutes.
Mechanically disrupt the Gastruloids using a P1000 coated in Staining Buffer.
Place the tube back in the 37 °C waterbath for another 4 minutes to complete digestion.
Mechanically disrupt the Gastruloids again using a P1000 coated in Staining Buffer until a single cell suspension is achieved.

steps.title: Filter Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Filter the digested cells into a FACS tube on ice.

substeps.instruction: Prewet the blue cap of a filter-FACS tube (e.g. CAT#352235, Falcon/Corning) by pipetting 1mL of Staining Buffer through it.
Filter the cell suspension through the cap of the FACS tube on ice.
Wash the filter by passing 1mL more of Digestion Solution through it on ice.

steps.title: Collect and Stop Digestion
steps.instruction: Transfer filtered cells and stop the enzymatic reaction on ice.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the contents of the FACS tube to a clean 15mL Falcon tube.
Flush the old FACS tube with 2mL Staining Buffer to collect leftover cells and transfer them to the 15mL Falcon tube.
Add 5mL more Staining buffer to the Falcon tube to completely stop the digestion reaction.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Stain with DAPI
steps.instruction: Pellet the cells and stain with DAPI on ice.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the cell suspension at 200 x g, 4 °C for 4 minutes.
Prepare 500uL of 0.2ug/mL DAPI in Staining Buffer (using a 1:5000 dilution from a 1mg/mL stock; e.g., 0.1uL DAPI in 500uL Staining Buffer).
Resuspend the cell pellet in the DAPI solution and incubate on ice for 15 minutes.
Spin down the cell suspension at 200 x g, 4 °C for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Fix Cells
steps.instruction: Fix the stained cells using PFA on ice.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the DAPI-stained cell pellet in 2mL 1% PFA.
Spin down the cell suspension at 200 x g, 4 °C for 4 minutes.
Resuspend cells in 300uL Staining Buffer and transfer to a clean FACS tube pre-coated with Staining Buffer.

steps.title: Process 2D Culture Controls
steps.instruction: Prepare 2D-grown reporter or single-color cells as controls.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate medium from the culture dish, wash with 3mL PBS-/-, and aspirate again.
Add 500uL Accutase to detach cells; incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer detached cells and Accutase to a clean Falcon tube.
Add ~5mL 10% Serum to stop the reaction.
Spin down the cell suspension at 200 x g, 4 °C for 4 minutes.
Process these cells following the same steps as the Gastruloid samples.

steps.title: Storage and Analysis
steps.instruction: Store or distribute cells for sorting.

substeps.instruction: If needed, store cells in Staining Buffer at 4 °C in the dark (wrapped in aluminum foil) for up to one week.
When ready for FACS, distribute cells on ice in 300uL per FACS tube for sorting/analysis.
